title: Secrets of Abode of Clouds
tagline: Private bespoke luxury across Cherrapunji, Dawki & Shillong
highlights: Private boat safari on glass-like Dawki Umngot river
Sunset high-tea over Laitlum Canyon gorge
Exclusive trek to Double Decker Living Root Bridges with local guide
Stargazing luxury eco-resort stay in Cherrapunji
description: An intimate journey designed for couples and private families seeking quiet grandeur, mist-laden valleys, and hidden natural pools with dedicated private 4x4 chauffeur.

title: Living Root Bridges & Canyons Odyssey
tagline: Trek through ancient rainforest paths and sacred mossy sanctuaries

Natural pool swimming at Rainbow Falls
Khasi herbal wellness bath & authentic homecooked feast
Caving exploration in Mawmluh cave system
description: Immerse into ancient botanical engineering where bio-sculpted roots form living footbridges over roaring turquoise rivers.

title: Crystal Waters & Turquoise Pools

Camping under clear starry skies by the riverbank
Krang Suri waterfall natural pool swimming
Visit Mawlynnong - Asia's cleanest village

Organic farm-to-table cuisine prepared with indigenous herbs
Storytelling around bonfire with tribal village elders

Highland tea tasting overlooking mist gorges
